# Actual production daemon: default retains S05 lifetime request deduplication.
server start
skygo jobs retention
stdout '^enabled: false\n'
taskfile task.json success
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-id disabled --wait
job-id JOB
event-count 1
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-id disabled --wait
stdout '"id": *"'$JOB'"'
event-count 1
skygo jobs logs $JOB
stdout '^retained workload output\n$'
! skygo run -f task.json --request-domain 11111111111111111111111111111111:1 --request-id forbidden
stderr 'retention is disabled'
event-count 1
# Offline activation cannot take a live writer or silently change its policy.
! skygo state retention enable --data-dir $DATA --request-window 1h
stderr 'timeout'
server stop
! stderr .
